title: Accuracy Review(TM) Results
text: Separate native window 'Accuracy Review 2025' (888x700) with its own chrome: target icon + 'Accuracy Review(TM)' header, CLOSE, Help Center + FAQs rail (Why should I finish my return before I run the Accuracy Review? / Do I have to correct all of the data verifications? / How can I go back to an Interview topic? / How can I review my entire return? / How do I unmark a tentative entry? / How do I cancel an overridden entry? / How can I talk with an H&R Block support specialist? / How can I get professional help...), toolbar FORMS LIST + SEARCH. Body: 'Our Accuracy Review found some issues we want to go over with you. Click Continue to view the possible inaccuracies and oversights. We'll work on them together.' Red (!) '2 Issues - Address these items before filing your return.' Orange (!) '1 Data Verification - Review these items before filing. Some are just reminders, but others require action.' [Continue]. Footer SHOW LIST.
